headline: Emily Wilson’s Pan of ‘The Odyssey’ Ignites a Debate Among Classicists and Commenters
context: Wilson, whose 2017 translation of Homer’s Greek classic influenced the director Christopher Nolan, panned his screenplay for the movie version in an essay for The London Review of Books.
